account.title: Account
account.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the interface

hideShell.label: Hide the Shell tab
hideShell.description: Takes the terminal out of the workspace. A running session isn't stopped — it keeps going the same way it does while you're on another tab, and the server ends it half an hour after nothing is connected.

hideTasks.label: Hide the Tasks tab
hideTasks.description: Takes the task board out of the workspace. Your tasks stay where they are.
hideTasks.unavailable: TaskMaster isn't installed here, so there is no Tasks tab to hide.

chatFontSize.label: Chat text size
chatFontSize.description: How large messages are set in the transcript. Tool cards and the rest of the app keep their own size.

simpleChatList.label: Simple chat list
simpleChatList.description: Replace the project tree with a flat list of the chats you start here.

simpleChatProject.label: Project for new chats
simpleChatProject.description: New chats in the simple list start in this project.

inputSettings.title: Input Settings
inputSettings.sendByCtrlEnterDescription: When enabled, pressing Ctrl+Enter will send the message instead of just Enter. This is useful for IME users to avoid accidental sends.

voiceSettings.title: Voice
voiceSettings.description: Speech-to-text input and read-aloud, via an OpenAI-compatible audio backend.
voiceSettings.enableDescription: Show the mic button and the read-aloud button on messages.
voiceSettings.backendDescription: Point at OpenAI, Groq, or a local server (LocalAI, Speaches, Kokoro-FastAPI). Leave blank to use the server default.
voiceSettings.note: A custom base URL is called directly by your browser and must allow browser CORS requests. Leave it blank to use the server-configured backend.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Control which notification events you receive.

desktop.title: Notify this desktop app

sound.title: Sound

darkMode.label: Dark Mode

projectSorting.label: Project Sorting
projectSorting.description: How projects are ordered in the sidebar

followSun.label: Follow sunrise and sunset
followSun.description: Switch to dark at sunset and back at sunrise, using your time zone. Choosing Dark Mode by hand turns this off.

codex.description: Controls how Codex handles file modifications and command execution

default.title: Default
default.description: Runs commands within the workspace sandbox. Codex decides when approval is needed; requests cannot be approved in this non-interactive integration.

acceptEdits.title: Accept Edits
acceptEdits.description: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.

bypassPermissions.title: Bypass Permissions
bypassPermissions.description: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.

technicalInfo.default: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=on-request. Runs commands within the workspace sandbox. Codex decides when approval is needed; requests cannot be approved in this non-interactive integration.
technicalInfo.acceptEdits: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=never. All commands auto-execute within project directory.
technicalInfo.bypassPermissions: sandboxMode=danger-full-access, approvalPolicy=never. Full system access, use only in trusted environments.
technicalInfo.overrideNote: You can override this per-session using the mode button in the chat interface.
